signals.text: Penders error & Palmer sees red - player ratings for Chelsea v Spurs. Goalkeeper Mike Penders endures a difficult first Premier League start, scoring an own goal in Spurs' 2-0 win at Chelsea. Here's how we - and you - rated the players.

Spurs boss Ho wants 'more support and training' for WSL referees. Tottenham manager Martin Ho was frustrated by a penalty decision in their defeat by Arsenal and says Women's Super League referees "need more support".
Jackson stars with two goals - player ratings for Aston Villa v Man City. How Aston Villa and Man City players rated following their Premier League match.

Forest left frustrated as winless run goes on after draw at Ipswich. Nottingham Forest ended a run of three successive league defeats but endured another night of missed chances as they drew 1-1 at Ipswich Town in the Premier League, but the result does move the away side out of the relegation zone on goal difference.
